svg.title: Aether — Cloud · Access control
svg.desc: Cloud file sharing with precise permission control. Private, restricted and public access, password-locked links that expire, uploads streamed straight to S3. Access: Private · Restricted · Public. Stack: Next.js · Prisma · PostgreSQL. Storage: Amazon S3 · Presigned uploads. Auth: Better Auth · Rate-limited.
